title: 아래 스틸링 매크로 다시 올립니다.
bodyHtml:
*준비물
-자신의 벡팩
Bread Leaf 20개(술집)
Apple 20개(잡화점)
Gold Coin 1200지피
Brank Scroll 20개(마법상점)
Empty Bottle 20개(마법상점)
-짐말의 벡팩(비틀이는 안됨)
Dying Tub 20개(테일러상점)

*설명
울온은 2D, 영문이어야 하며
울온창내의 게임화면은 800x600으로 맞춰야함
이지유오를 실행하고 아래 스크립트를 복사해서 붙여넣고 실행
Begin버튼를 누르고 3가지 중 버튼중
I have what I need and I'm ready to begin버튼을 누르고나서
타겟이 뜨면 짐말을 클릭해주면 됨.
Dying Tub(염색통)은 스킬90이후부터 Enable시키고 사용하면됨
펠루카에서만 가능하며 마을에서도 가능함

;*************************************
;Ceed's Stealing Trainer v1.13
;ⓒ Minoc Miner Murderer (2003)
;*************************************

;PURPOSE:  Just another stealing trainer...

;FUNCTIONS:  This script is designed to steal scrolls, bottles, gold, dye tubs, or any combination
;of the four in rotation.  It has options for feeding your pack animal and for feeding your character.
;It has a display to monitor your progress and the scripts progress.  Just hit play, choose your
;options and the script will tell you what you need as well as let you get it without restarting the script

;*************************************************History**********************************************************
;v1.00 first running version with working display, only usable options so far are gold stealing and eating
;v1.01 fixed a few bugs, adjusted amounts to steal
;v1.02 restacking feature added, still has bugs
;v1.03 gold stealing, feeding and restacking all running smoothly now
;v1.04 gold, scrolls and bottle stealing all operational now, alternate targets still inop
;v1.05 Alternate between targets when multiple objects are selected is now operational
;v1.06 revamped the menu code
;v1.07 fix for occasionally not dragging an item to steal
;v1.09 fixed a pack animal feeding issue
;v1.10 added #contkind checks to most sections to keep the script from hanging up
;v1.11 final fixes for latency/lag, tested through 3,000 consecutive steals with no hang ups
;v1.12 dye tub support added
;v1.13 public release

;*************************************************NOTES*********************************************************
;beetles are not yet supported, don't try to use one or the script will not function correctly
;
;skill lock code to be added in future version

;***********************************************Set Variables*****************************************************
;%screenresx & %screenresy = You're UO game window resolution

;%delay & %shortdelay = Adjust these if latency problems with the script

;%stealdelay = Tweak this to your system, if you get "You must wait" msgs when stealing set it higher
;the number you enter will be read as seconds (i.e. set %stealdelay 8, the delay will be 8 seconds)

;%eat, %feed, %gold, %bottles, %scrolls, %tubs are all defaults for the menu.
;set them to 0 to be enabled and to 1 to be disabled.  Don't set them to anything else!

;%skipintro forces the script to bypass the title screen and go straight to the menu when set to 0

;**********Edit these for each patch*********

set %dragkind ACIB
set %dragcontkind KJQC

;*****************customize these******************
set %screenresx 800
set %screenresy 600

set %delay 30
set %shortdelay 10

set %stealdelay 7

set %eat 0
set %feed 0
set %gold 0
set %bottles 0
set %scrolls 0
set %tubs 1

set %skipintro 1

;**************************************don't edit anything beyond this point***************************************

initevents
set #findmod 0_0
set %beetletype ZGB
set %meattype VRD
set %fishtype MGG
set %fruittypes FWI_TWI_UWI_PQD_QQD
set %goldtype POF
set %bottletype WUF
set %scrolltype DPF
set %tubtype DBG
set %dragtypes POF_WUF_DPF
set %self #charid
set #ltargetkind 1
set %centerx %screenresx / 2
set %centery %screenresy / 2
set %dontmovecursor 1
click 200 200 n
wait %shortdelay
click 100 100 n
wait %shortdelay
if #CURSORX = 100
{
if #CURSORY = 100
set %dontmovecursor 0
}
set %fish 1
set %packfood 1
set %goldstack 1
set %bottlestack 1
set %scrollstack 1
set %present 0
set %random 0
set %count 1
set %success 0
set %firstrun 1

;*********************Intro*********************

menu clear
if %skipintro = 0
        goto skip
gosub mainsetup
set %cnt -5

Loop1:
        set %cnt %cnt + 5
        set %cnt2 150 - %cnt
        wait 1
        gosub printtext
                if %cnt < 60
                        goto Loop1
        wait 2s
        set %col 255

Loop2:
        menu font color %col
        set %col %col - 5
        wait 1
        gosub printtext
                if %col > 0
                        goto Loop2

skip:

;*******************************************************SCRIPT*********************************************************

begin:
gosub buildmenu
}
gosub menuloop
}
NotFound:
ignoreitem reset 1
gosub display1
}
Unpause2:
gosub display4
}
gosub initialize
}
gosub options
}
set %cnt 0
set %cnt1 0
menu font style B
menu delete SKILL1
menu text SKILL1 200 5 Current Skill:
menu delete GAIN1
menu text GAIN1 200 20 Gain:
menu delete ATTE1
menu text ATTE1 200 35 Attempts:
set %wait #scnt
set %feedtimer #scnt
set %eattimer #scnt
}
stealingloop:
}
menu delete STAT
gosub calculate
}
gosub options
}
menu delete STAT
menu delete DISP
menu text STAT 50 5 Working
if %feed = 0
        gosub feed
}
if %eat = 0
        gosub eat
}
gosub chooseitem
}
Item_drag:
}
menu delete DISP
menu text DISP 15 30 Dragging an item to steal...
}
gosub dragitem
menu delete DISP
}
gosub waiting
}
menu delete STAT
menu text STAT 50 5 Working
menu delete DISP
menu text DISP 15 30 Stealing...
gosub steal
}
if %success = 1 3
        menu delete DISP
        menu text DISP 15 30 Restacking...
        gosub restack
menu delete DISP
menu delete STAT
goto stealingloop


;********************************************************SUBS**********************************************************
sub mainsetup
        menu clear
        menu window size 400 200
        menu window title Ceed's Stealing Trainer v1.13
        menu window color black
        menu font bgcolor BLACK
        menu font color RED
        menu font size 16
        menu font style BI
        menu hideeuo
        menu show
return

sub printtext
        menu delete TEXT1
        menu delete TEXT2
        menu text TEXT1 50 %cnt Stealing Trainer v1.13
        menu text TEXT2 100 %cnt2 ⓒ Minoc Miner Murderer$
return

sub buildmenu
        menu clear
        menu hideeuo
        menu window size 400 235
        menu window title Ceed's Stealing Trainer v1.13
        menu window color black
        menu font bgcolor black
        menu font color red
        menu font size 9
        menu font style BI
        menu button 1 50 10 100 20 Feed Animal:
        menu font size 10
        menu font style
                if %feed = 0
                        menu text ANIM 155 10 Yes
                if %feed = 1
                        menu text ANIM 155 10 No
        menu font size 9
        menu font style BI
        menu button 2 200 10 100 20 Eat Fishsteaks:
        menu font size 10
        menu font style
                if %eat = 0
                        menu text EAT 305 10 Yes
                if %eat = 1
                        menu text EAT 305 10 No
        menu font size 14
        menu font style BIU
        menu text CHOICE 75 40 What will you use to train?
        menu font size 12
        menu font style BI
        menu button 3 90 70 120 25 Gold
        menu font style
                if %gold = 0
                        menu text GOLD 235 70 Enabled
                if %gold = 1
                        menu text GOLD 235 70 Disabled
        menu font style BI
        menu button 4 90 100 120 25 Bottles
        menu font style
                if %bottles = 0
                        menu text BOTT 235 100 Enabled
                if %bottles = 1
                        menu text BOTT 235 100 Disabled
        menu font style BI
        menu button 5 90 130 120 25 Blank Scrolls
        menu font style
                if %scrolls = 0
                        menu text SCROLL 235 130 Enabled
                if %scrolls = 1
                        menu text SCROLL 235 130 Disabled
        menu font style BI
        menu button 6 90 160 120 25 Dye Tubs
        menu font style
                if %tubs = 0
                        menu text TUBS 235 160 Enabled
                if %tubs = 1
                        menu text TUBS 235 160 Disabled
        menu font size 10
        menu font style B
        menu button 7 175 200 50 20 Begin
        menu show
return

sub display1
        unpause:
        menu clear
        menu window size 400 235
        menu window title Ceed's Stealing Trainer v1.13
        menu window color black
        menu font bgcolor black
        menu font color red
        menu font style B
        menu font size 12
        set %a 0
        set %b 5
        set %c 20
        set %d 0
        set %e 40
        menu delete A
        menu text A %b %b For those options you will need the following:
        set %a %a + 1
        set %d %b + %e
        menu font size 10
        menu font style
        menu text B %c %d %a ) A pack animal under your control.
                if %feed = 0 4
                        set %a %a + 1
                        set %d %d + %c
                        menu delete C
                        menu text C %c %d %a ) A stack of fruit/meat in your main pack for your animal.
                if %eat = 0 4
                        set %a %a + 1
                        set %d %d + %c
                        menu delete D
                        menu text D %c %d %a ) A stack of fishsteaks in your main pack.
                if %gold = 0 4
                        set %a %a + 1
                        set %d %d + %c
                        menu delete E
                        menu text E %c %d %a ) A pile of at least 600 gold in your main pack.
                if %bottles = 0 4
                        set %a %a + 1
                        set %d %d + %c
                        menu delete F
                        menu text F %c %d %a ) A stack of at least 15 bottles in your main pack.
                if %scrolls = 0 4
                        set %a %a + 1
                        set %d %d + %c
                        menu delete G
                        menu text G %c %d %a ) A stack of at least 15 scrolls in your main pack.
                if %tubs = 0 4
                        set %a %a + 1
                        set %d %d + %c
                        menu delete H
                        menu text H %c %d %a ) You're pack horse loaded with dye tubs (at least 10).
        set %d %d + %e + %b
        menu font size 12
        menu font style B
        menu text I %b %d '*'NOTE'*' You must be in a guild if you wish to$
                + avoid flagging criminal while running this script!
        set %d %d + %e + %c
        menu font size 8
        menu button 1 75 %d 250 15 Pause the script until I get my things
        set %d %d + 20
        menu button 2 75 %d 250 15 Exit the script entirely
        set %d %d + 20
        menu button 3 75 %d 250 15 I have what I need and I'm ready to begin
        set %d %d + 30
        menu window size 400 %d
        settingsmenu:
        set #menubutton N/A
                settingsmenuloop:
                        if #menubutton = N/A
                                goto settingsmenuloop
        goto B , #menubutton
        B1:
                gosub display3
                goto unpause
        B2:
                menu hide
                halt
        B3:        
                goto Unpause2
return

sub display3
        menu clear
        menu window size 200 50
        menu window title Ceed's Stealing Trainer v1.13
        menu window color black
        menu font bgcolor black
        menu font color red
        menu font style B
        menu font size 10
        menu button RES 50 30 100 15 Resume
        menu font size 12
        set #menubutton N/A
                pausedloop:
                        menu delete p1
                        menu text p1 70 3 Paused
                        wait 1
                        menu delete p1
                        menu text p1 70 3 Paused.
                        wait 1
                        menu delete p1
                        menu text p1 70 3 Paused..
                        wait 1
                        menu delete p1
                        menu text p1 70 3 Paused...
                        wait 1
                        menu delete p1
                        menu text p1 70 3 Paused....
                                if #menubutton = N/A
                                        goto pausedloop
        goto unpause
return

sub display4
        menu clear
        menu window size 350 55
        menu window title Ceed's Stealing Trainer v1.13
        menu window color black
        menu font bgcolor black
        menu font color red
        menu font style B
        menu font size 10
        menu text STATP 5 5 Status:
        menu font style
return

sub initialize
        menu delete STAT
        menu text STAT 50 5 Initializing
        wait 1
        menu delete DISP
        menu text DISP 15 30 Opening paperdoll...
        wait 1
        event macro 8 1
        wait %delay
        contpos 630 -65
        set %doll #contid
        wait %delay
        menu delete STAT
        menu text STAT 50 5 Initializing
        menu delete DISP
        menu text DISP 15 30 Opening backpack...
        wait 1
        event macro 8 7
        wait %delay
        contpos 600 375
        set %mainbag #contid
        wait %delay
        menu delete STAT
        menu text STAT 50 5 Initializing
        menu delete DISP
        menu text DISP 15 30 Target your pack animal
        set #targcurs 1
                targetpackloop:
                        if #targcurs = 1
                                goto targetpackloop
        menu delete DISP
        menu text DISP 15 30 Preparing pack animal...
        wait %delay
        set %packie #ltargetid
        set #lobjectid %packie
        msg #smc All follow me$
        wait %shortdelay
        msg #smc All guard me$
        wait %shortdelay
        msg #smc All guard me$
        wait %delay
        event macro 17
        wait %delay
        contpos 375 375
        wait %delay
        set %packbag #contid
        finditem %packie
        set %packietype #findtype
        menu delete STAT
        menu text STAT 50 5 Initializing
        menu delete DISP
        menu text DISP 15 30 Searching for items...
        wait 1
                finditems:
                        if %feed = 0 30
                        if %packfood = 1 29
                                if %packietype <> %beetletype 14
                                        finditem %fruittypes
                                                if #findkind = 1 2
                                                        ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                        goto finditems
                                                if #findkind = -1 4
                                                        menu delete DISP
                                                        menu text DISP 15 30 You don't have any fruit!
                                                        wait 5s
                                                        goto NotFound
                                                if #findbagid <> %mainbag 2
                                                        ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                        goto finditems
                                        set %packfood #findid
                                        goto findfish
                                finditem %meattype
                                        if #findkind = 1 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findkind = -1 4
                                                menu delete DISP
                                                menu text DISP 15 30 You don't have any meat!
                                                wait 5s
                                                goto NotFound
                                        if #findbagid <> %mainbag 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                set %packfood #findid
                                findfish:                                
                        if %eat = 0 14
                        if %fish = 1 13
                                finditem %fishtype
                                        if #findkind = 1 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findkind = -1 4
                                                menu delete DISP
                                                menu text DISP 15 30 You don't have any fish!
                                                wait 5s
                                                goto NotFound
                                        if #findbagid <> %mainbag 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        set %fish #findid
                        if %gold = 0 17
                        if %goldstack = 1 16
                                finditem %goldtype
                                        if #findkind = 1 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findkind = -1 4
                                                menu delete DISP
                                                menu text DISP 15 30 You don't have enough gold!
                                                wait 5s
                                                goto NotFound
                                        if #findbagid <> %mainbag 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findstack < 600 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                set %goldstack #findid
                        if %scrolls = 0 17
                        if %scrollstack = 1 16
                                finditem %scrolltype
                                        if #findkind = 1 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findkind = -1 4
                                                menu delete DISP
                                                menu text DISP 15 30 You don't have enough scrolls!
                                                wait 5s
                                                goto NotFound
                                        if #findbagid <> %mainbag 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findstack < 15 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                set %scrollstack #findid
                        if %bottles = 0 17
                        if %bottlestack = 1 16
                                finditem %bottletype
                                        if #findkind = 1 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findkind = -1 4
                                                menu delete DISP
                                                menu text DISP 15 30 You don't have enough bottles!
                                                wait 5s
                                                goto NotFound
                                        if #findbagid <> %mainbag 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findstack < 15 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                set %bottlestack #findid
                        if %tubs = 0 14
                        if %present = 0 13
                                finditem %tubtype
                                        if #findkind = 1 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                        if #findkind = -1 4
                                                menu delete DISP
                                                menu text DISP 15 30 You don't have any tubs on your pack animal!
                                                wait 5s
                                                goto NotFound
                                        if #findbagid <> %packbag 2
                                                ignoreitem #findid 1
                                                goto finditems
                                set %present 1
        menu delete DISP
return
